airecServices.title: AI Strategy Consulting
airecServices.tagline: Identify the right AI opportunities. Understand what it will take to deliver them.
airecServices.subheading: Define what is worth building before committing to development.
airecServices.body: We assess your workflows, data, and business requirements to identify valuable AI opportunities. You receive prioritized use cases, technical feasibility findings, and an implementation roadmap with clear dependencies and success criteria.
introParagraphs: AIREC helps organizations turn business challenges into technically grounded AI initiatives.
We assess where AI could improve your workflows, whether your data and systems can support the proposed solution, and how to move from an initial idea to a measurable implementation.

capabilities.title: Opportunity Discovery & Problem Framing
capabilities.description:
We examine workflows, manual tasks, information bottlenecks, and recurring decisions to identify potential AI use cases.

Each opportunity is translated into a defined task with expected inputs, outputs, users, and system interactions. We assess its potential value against implementation complexity, operating cost, and the consequences of failure.

capabilities.title: Data & Organizational Readiness
capabilities.description:
We review the availability, quality, ownership, and accessibility of relevant data, including structured records, documents, images, and operational logs.

The assessment identifies preparation requirements such as cleaning, labeling, document processing, access permissions, and update processes. We also establish who will own the workflow, review outputs, and maintain the system.

capabilities.title: Technical Feasibility
capabilities.description:
We compare possible approaches, which may include existing model APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, task-specific machine learning, model fine-tuning, or non-AI automation.

We examine integration constraints, expected request volumes, latency requirements, deployment options, and compute needs. Where validation is included, focused experiments test the assumptions most likely to affect the recommendation.

capabilities.title: Architecture & Implementation Planning
capabilities.description:
We define the proposed components, data flows, model interfaces, application integrations, and operational controls.

The roadmap separates feasibility work, pilot deployment, and production engineering. Each stage includes dependencies, indicative resource requirements, and criteria for continuing, revising, or stopping the initiative.

meta.title: AI Strategy Consulting & Implementation Roadmaps | AIREC
meta.description: Identify valuable AI use cases, assess technical readiness, and define a practical architecture and implementation roadmap with AIREC.

airecServices.title: Custom AI Development & Integration
airecServices.tagline: Build an AI system that fits your product, data, and operations.
airecServices.subheading: Build an AI system around your requirements.
airecServices.body: We design and develop AI-enabled applications, backend services, and integrations. Our work connects models, data pipelines, business logic, and deployment infrastructure into systems that fit your products and operations.
introParagraphs: AIREC designs and develops AI-enabled systems around specific business and technical requirements.

We bring models, application services, data pipelines, and enterprise integrations together into a working solution. The engagement covers not only the AI component, but also the engineering required to make it usable, testable, and maintainable.

capabilities.title: AI Application Architecture
capabilities.description:
We define the responsibilities of application services, models, orchestration components, storage, and external systems.

The architecture establishes API contracts, authentication requirements, processing boundaries, and deployment dependencies. AI-generated outputs are separated from the application rules that govern permissions, transactions, and consequential actions.

capabilities.title: Data & Model Integration
capabilities.description:
We connect approved data sources with the processing and model components required by the application.

This may include ingestion pipelines, preprocessing, retrieval services, model inference, and structured output validation. Data freshness, access permissions, and error handling are incorporated into the integration design.

capabilities.title: Backend Services & Business-System Integrations
capabilities.description:
We develop service APIs and processing workflows that connect AI capabilities with your existing software.

Where needed, we support asynchronous jobs, event-driven processing, request validation, and controlled interaction with third-party APIs. Integrations are designed around the interfaces and access available within your environment.

capabilities.title: Testing & Release Engineering
capabilities.description:
We combine software testing with task-specific AI evaluation.

The test plan can include unit and integration tests, representative evaluation datasets, output validation, regression checks, and load testing. Models, prompts, configurations, and application code are versioned so changes can be assessed before release.

capabilities.title: Deployment & Operational Controls
capabilities.description:
We prepare the application for its agreed hosting environment, whether that involves managed services, self-hosted infrastructure, or a hybrid design.

Deployment work can include containerization, configuration and secrets management, health checks, logging, monitoring, and rollback procedures. We define how failures are surfaced and what the application should do when an AI component is unavailable.

meta.title: Custom AI Development & System Integration | AIREC
meta.description: Build custom AI applications with AIREC, covering architecture, data integration, backend engineering, evaluation, and deployment.

airecServices.title: AI Agents & Workflow Automation
airecServices.tagline: Move from AI-generated answers to controlled workflow execution.
airecServices.subheading: Connect AI-assisted decisions with controlled actions.
airecServices.body: We develop tool-using agents and automated workflows that retrieve information, coordinate tasks, and interact with business systems. Permissions, approval checkpoints, exception handling, and execution monitoring are designed around the workflow.
introParagraphs: AIREC develops AI agents and automation systems that work across information sources, application interfaces, and business processes.

We combine model-assisted interpretation with explicitly defined tools, workflow logic, and execution controls. The goal is to automate suitable tasks while keeping responsibilities and decision boundaries clear.

capabilities.title: Tool-Using AI Agents
capabilities.description:
We develop agents that can retrieve information, call approved APIs, prepare structured outputs, and coordinate defined tasks.

Tool interfaces specify accepted inputs, available actions, and expected results. Permissions and action validation are enforced in the surrounding application rather than relying only on instructions given to the model.

capabilities.title: Workflow Orchestration
capabilities.description:
We connect AI-assisted steps with deterministic processing, business rules, and system integrations.

Workflows can include triggers, routing decisions, persistent state, approval stages, and asynchronous processing. We define how work resumes after an interruption and how completed actions are tracked to reduce unintended repetition.

capabilities.title: Business-System Integrations
capabilities.description:
We connect agents with the systems required for the workflow, such as internal databases, document repositories, ticketing platforms, or customer-management tools.

Integrations use scoped credentials and explicit access boundaries. The agent receives only the interfaces and information needed for its assigned responsibilities.

capabilities.title: Human Oversight & Approval Controls
capabilities.description:
We design review points around the consequences of each action.

A workflow might automatically classify a request or assemble a draft while requiring approval before sending an external message, changing a sensitive record, or executing an irreversible action. Approval history and execution outcomes can be recorded for review.

capabilities.title: Reliability & Failure Handling
capabilities.description:
We define timeouts, retry limits, fallback paths, escalation rules, and execution budgets.

Retrieved content and tool responses are treated as untrusted inputs. We test how the system handles missing information, malformed responses, conflicting instructions, and attempted actions outside its permissions.

meta.title: AI Agent Development & Workflow Automation | AIREC
meta.description: Develop AI agents and automated workflows with tool integrations, controlled execution, human approvals, and task-level evaluation.

airecServices.title: Generative AI & LLM Solutions
airecServices.tagline: Turn your knowledge and documents into useful AI applications.
airecServices.subheading: Make organizational knowledge and language data more useful.
airecServices.body: We build knowledge assistants, document-processing applications, and conversational systems using large language models. Our work covers retrieval, model adaptation, application integration, and evaluation against your actual tasks.
introParagraphs: AIREC develops applications that use large language models to retrieve information, interpret documents, generate structured outputs, and support conversation.
We design these systems around your data, users, and operating requirements, with attention to information access, answer quality, application integration, and deployment cost.

capabilities.title: RAG & Enterprise Knowledge Assistants
capabilities.description:
We develop retrieval-augmented generation systems that connect language models with approved organizational knowledge.

The implementation can include document ingestion, parsing, chunking, indexing, search, reranking, and source attribution. We design retrieval around document permissions and establish how updated or removed content is reflected in the system.

capabilities.title: Document Intelligence & Structured Extraction
capabilities.description:
We build workflows for extracting, classifying, summarizing, and organizing information from documents.

The design specifies document types, required fields, output schemas, validation rules, and review conditions. Processing exceptions are surfaced rather than silently accepted, and uncertain or incomplete results can be routed for human review.

capabilities.title: Conversational AI Applications
capabilities.description:
We develop assistants for defined information and interaction tasks.

The implementation can include conversation state, context management, knowledge retrieval, structured responses, and handover to a person or another system. We establish what the assistant should answer, what it should ask, and when it should decline or escalate a request.

capabilities.title: Model Adaptation & Fine-Tuning
capabilities.description:
We assess prompting, retrieval, model selection, and fine-tuning against an existing baseline.

Where adaptation is justified, we prepare task-specific examples, training configurations, and evaluation sets. Candidate models are compared against the same acceptance criteria before being selected for integration.

capabilities.title: LLM Evaluation & Inference Optimization
capabilities.description:
We evaluate the parts of the system that affect the userâ€™s task, including retrieval relevance, support for answers in source material, extraction quality, response consistency, latency, and cost.

Depending on the deployment, optimization work may include context reduction, caching, batching, quantization, or model routing. Changes are tested for both performance and task quality.

meta.title: Generative AI, RAG & LLM Development Services | AIREC
meta.description: Build knowledge assistants, document intelligence, and conversational AI with AIRECâ€™s retrieval, model adaptation, and evaluation services.

airecServices.title: AI Research & Prototyping
airecServices.tagline: Test the technical uncertainty before committing to a full build.
airecServices.subheading: Test uncertain ideas before making larger engineering commitments.
airecServices.body: We investigate technical questions, compare approaches, and build focused prototypes. Each engagement produces evidence about what works, where limitations remain, and whether further development is justified.
introParagraphs: AIREC helps organizations investigate AI problems where the appropriate approach is not yet clear.

We translate open technical questions into experiments, develop focused prototypes, and compare results against explicit criteria. The outcome is evidence that supports a development decision, not simply a demonstration that appears convincing.

capabilities.title: Technical Exploration & Method Selection
capabilities.description:
We review relevant approaches and identify candidates suited to the problem and available resources.

This may involve established methods, pretrained models, task-specific learning, retrieval approaches, or alternative system architectures. We document why each candidate is included and which assumptions it is intended to test.

capabilities.title: Experimental Design & Baselines
capabilities.description:
We establish datasets, evaluation procedures, baseline methods, and comparison criteria.

The experiment is designed to distinguish genuine improvement from differences in data, configuration, or test conditions. Where appropriate, we use component-level comparisons to identify which parts of a proposed method contribute to the result.

capabilities.title: Focused Proof-of-Concept Development
capabilities.description:
We build the smallest implementation needed to test the central technical question.

A prototype may cover a document-processing task, agent workflow, predictive model, or perception component. Its boundaries are explicit so a successful experiment is not mistaken for a complete production system.

capabilities.title: Benchmarking & Failure Analysis
capabilities.description:
We compare candidate approaches on relevant quality, latency, resource use, and cost measures.

We inspect failure cases, sensitivity to input changes, and performance across important subsets of the test data. Results are reported with the limitations needed to interpret them appropriately.

capabilities.title: Engineering Recommendations
capabilities.description:
We translate findings into a clear recommendation: continue with the selected approach, revise the method, collect additional data, or avoid further investment under the current conditions.

Where development is justified, we identify the integration, testing, and operational work that remains.

meta.title: Applied AI Research & Prototyping Services | AIREC
meta.description: Test uncertain AI ideas through applied research, comparative experiments, focused prototypes, and technical feasibility evaluation.

airecServices.title: Predictive Analytics & Machine Learning
airecServices.tagline: Use your data to anticipate outcomes and support better decisions.
airecServices.subheading: Turn historical and operational data into decision support.
airecServices.body: We develop forecasting, classification, and anomaly-detection models, then integrate their outputs into practical workflows. Model validation, uncertainty, and ongoing performance measurement are considered from the beginning.
introParagraphs: AIREC develops machine learning systems that identify patterns, estimate future outcomes, and surface information for operational decision-making.

We work across data preparation, feature development, model training, validation, and application integration. The focus is on producing outputs that fit a defined decision or workflow, with clear assumptions and measurable performance.

capabilities.title: Data Assessment & Feature Engineering
capabilities.description:
We assess source data for completeness, consistency, coverage, and suitability for the target task.

Preparation can include cleaning, joining records, handling missing values, and developing features from historical activity. We check that training inputs reflect information available at prediction time, rather than unintentionally including future outcomes.

capabilities.title: Forecasting Models
capabilities.description:
We develop forecasting approaches for defined operational quantities, such as demand, workload, transaction volume, or resource requirements.

Candidate methods are compared with relevant baselines using historical evaluation windows. We assess performance across forecast horizons and important operating conditions, with uncertainty reporting suited to the model and task.

capabilities.title: Classification & Predictive Scoring
capabilities.description:
We build models that assign categories, estimate event likelihoods, or rank items for review.

The implementation defines the target, feature set, decision thresholds, and handling of uncertain cases. Evaluation considers the practical costs of different errors rather than relying on a single aggregate accuracy figure.

capabilities.title: Anomaly Detection
capabilities.description:
We develop methods for identifying observations or patterns that warrant further investigation.

The workflow defines what is being monitored, how alerts are prioritized, and how reviewers provide feedback. We treat an anomaly score as a signal for the agreed process, not automatic proof that an incident or fault has occurred.

capabilities.title: Decision-Support Integration
capabilities.description:
We connect model outputs with the interfaces used by your team, such as service APIs, scheduled reports, dashboards, or existing application workflows.

The design specifies prediction timing, output formats, thresholds, and human review requirements. Where explanations are included, we present them within the limits of the selected method.

meta.title: Predictive Analytics & Machine Learning Services | AIREC
meta.description: Develop forecasting, classification, and anomaly-detection models with practical data preparation, validation, integration, and monitoring.

airecProducts.name: MetaMindful
airecProducts.label: Product / 01
airecProducts.body: MetaMindful is AIREC's first AI product. It is a private conversational mental wellness experience designed to help people work through moments of overthinking and move toward practical action. Its approach is informed by Acceptance and Commitment Therapy principles and mindfulness.
moments: When avoidance is getting in the way.
When thoughts have become louder than the situation.
When someone knows something matters but struggles to move toward it.
boundaries: It does not diagnose mental health conditions.
It is not a replacement for medical care or treatment from a qualified mental health professional.

methodSteps.title: Explore
methodSteps.body: Study the human problem and technical possibilities around it.

methodSteps.title: Build
methodSteps.body: Turn the strongest approach into a useful product experience.

methodSteps.title: Learn
methodSteps.body: Let real-world use improve the product and inform future research.

airecFaqs.question: Do we need a specific AI use case before contacting AIREC?
airecFaqs.answer: No. We can begin with a business problem or workflow that needs improvement and determine whether an AI approach is appropriate.

airecFaqs.question: Does strategy consulting include a prototype?
airecFaqs.answer: A focused validation prototype can be included when needed to resolve a technical uncertainty. Full application development and production deployment are scoped separately.

airecFaqs.question: Can you evaluate an AI initiative that is already underway?
airecFaqs.answer: Yes. An assessment can focus on the existing architecture, data readiness, evaluation methods, operational risks, or the work required to move beyond a prototype.

airecFaqs.question: Can you add AI to an existing application?
airecFaqs.answer: Yes. We assess the existing architecture and identify how to introduce AI capabilities through services, APIs, or workflow integrations without assuming the entire application needs to be rebuilt.

airecFaqs.question: Can you develop an existing prototype into a deployed system?
airecFaqs.answer: Yes. We review what can be retained and identify gaps in testing, integration, security controls, performance, and operational support before planning further development.

airecFaqs.question: Who maintains the system after delivery?
airecFaqs.answer: We establish ownership during scoping. An engagement can include handover to your engineering team, a defined support arrangement, or additional development phases.

airecFaqs.question: Do we need a multi-agent system?
airecFaqs.answer: Not necessarily. We start with the simplest architecture that can meet the requirements. Additional agents are introduced only when separating responsibilities provides a clear, testable benefit.

airecFaqs.question: Can an agent operate without human approval?
airecFaqs.answer: Some authorized, low-risk steps can be automated. We define approval requirements for sensitive or consequential actions during workflow design rather than treating autonomy as an all-or-nothing choice.

airecFaqs.question: Do we need to train an AI model from scratch?
airecFaqs.answer: We first assess existing models and focus on tool design, context management, orchestration, and evaluation. Model adaptation is considered only where it addresses a demonstrated limitation.

airecFaqs.question: Should we use RAG or fine-tuning?
airecFaqs.answer: We evaluate them against different requirements. We consider retrieval for access to approved knowledge and fine-tuning for demonstrated task or behavioral needs. A solution may use either approach, both, or neither.

airecFaqs.question: Will our data be sent to a third-party model provider?
airecFaqs.answer: That depends on the agreed architecture. We establish data-processing boundaries before implementation and assess self-hosted or hybrid options where required.

airecFaqs.question: Can you guarantee that the model will never produce an incorrect answer?
airecFaqs.answer: No. We design for validation, source checking, evaluation, and appropriate escalation rather than promising error-free outputs. The acceptable use of the system depends on the task and consequences of mistakes.

airecFaqs.question: How is this different from AI strategy consulting?
airecFaqs.answer: Strategy consulting identifies and prioritizes opportunities. Research and prototyping investigate a specific technical uncertainty through experiments and working implementations.

airecFaqs.question: Does a successful prototype mean the system is ready for production?
airecFaqs.answer: No. A prototype validates a bounded question. Production work may still require broader testing, integrations, security controls, deployment engineering, and operational support.

airecFaqs.question: What happens when the proposed approach does not work?
airecFaqs.answer: We document the evidence, failure conditions, and available alternatives. A useful outcome may be identifying the data or method changes required, or establishing that the current approach should not proceed.

airecFaqs.question: How much historical data do we need?
airecFaqs.answer: We assess this against the task, event frequency, data quality, and required coverage. The initial review identifies whether the available data can support useful testing or whether collection and labeling should come first.

airecFaqs.question: Can you work with our existing reporting or analytics tools?
airecFaqs.answer: Yes. We assess how predictions or scores can be delivered through your existing interfaces, including batch outputs, APIs, reports, and dashboard integrations.

airecFaqs.question: Can the model guarantee a particular outcome?
airecFaqs.answer: No. We define performance targets for evaluation and report results with their assumptions and limitations. The system is designed to support an agreed decision process, not to promise certainty about future events.

airecFaqs.question: How can AI make complex work easier to understand and execute?
airecFaqs.answer: We design custom AI systems around workflows, information, decisions, and problems that conventional tools struggle to handle.

airecFaqs.question: What should intelligent systems automate, and where should people remain in control?
airecFaqs.answer: We build AI agents and automation for multi-step work while preserving human oversight where judgment matters.

airecFaqs.question: How can organizations turn fragmented knowledge into usable intelligence?
airecFaqs.answer: We build LLM, retrieval, document, language, and conversational systems that connect people with the information and capabilities they need.

airecFaqs.question: What happens when research reveals a problem worth solving at scale?
airecFaqs.answer: We turn validated ideas into products of our own. MetaMindful is the first expression of that ambition.

metamindfulFaqs.question: Is MetaMindful therapy?
metamindfulFaqs.answer: No. It's a self-help companion built on ACT principles. It can sit with you through a hard moment, but it doesn't diagnose, treat, or replace a therapist.

metamindfulFaqs.question: What exactly is a "Thread"?
metamindfulFaqs.answer: A Thread is a dedicated space to unpack a specific thought, emotion, or situation with step-by-step guidance.

metamindfulFaqs.question: How many threads can I create?
metamindfulFaqs.answer: You can create upto 3 threads as you need to explore and manage different thoughts, patterns, and exercises.

metamindfulFaqs.question: Does MetaMindful remember our previous conversations?
metamindfulFaqs.answer: Your privacy is central to how the product is designed. Conversations are saved privately within your personal account so you can revisit them anytime.

metamindfulFaqs.question: How long does a session take?
metamindfulFaqs.answer: You can use MetaMindful for a quick 2-3 minute reset or take longer to reflect and dive deeper into a structured exercise.

metamindfulFaqs.question: Who can see my conversations?
metamindfulFaqs.answer: Only you. Your conversations are private, encrypted, and never shared or used for public training.

sections.title: 1. INTRODUCTION
paragraphs: Welcome to MetaMindful. Your mental well-being is our priority, and that starts with the absolute privacy of your thoughts. This policy describes our data practices for the MetaMindful platform.

sections.title: 2. ACCOUNT AND DATA DELETION
paragraphs: You can delete your MetaMindful account at any time from within the app.

When your account is deleted, your account and the identifying connection to your saved conversations and Threads are removed. Your previous conversations will no longer be accessible to you, associated with your account, or restored if you create a new MetaMindful account later.
Conversation data may remain only after it has been anonymized as described in the Data Storage and Retention section.
You can also request account deletion by visiting https://metamindful.ai/delete-account/

sections.title: 3. DATA COLLECTION
paragraphs: We only collect data required to use the app:
bullets: Account Info: Your email and name for account management.
Coaching Threads: The text you share within "Threads" so the AI Coach can provide context-aware guidance.
No Hidden Data: We do not access your contacts, location, or camera without explicit, one-time permission for a specific feature.

sections.title: 4. DATA USAGE
paragraphs: Data is used to:
bullets: Personalize and enhance mindfulness recommendations.
Analyze usage patterns to continuously improve the user experience.
Resolve technical issues.

paragraphs: Your data is never used for advertising purposes or shared with third-party services for marketing.

sections.title: 5. DATA SHARING
paragraphs: We commit to not selling, renting, or sharing your personal data with any third parties. Anonymized, aggregated data might be used for research to improve mindfulness techniques, but without any identifying information.

sections.title: 6. DATA STORAGE AND RETENTION
paragraphs: We retain your account information, saved conversations, Threads, and related data while your MetaMindful account is active so you can return to your previous conversations and continue your progress.

When you delete your MetaMindful account, your account and the identifying connection between you and your conversation history are removed. Your previous conversations will no longer be accessible through your account, associated with your account, or restored if you create a new MetaMindful account later.

Conversation data may be retained only after it has been anonymized so that it is no longer associated with an identifiable MetaMindful account. Anonymized conversation data may be retained indefinitely for aggregate analytics, safety, and service improvement.
We use appropriate technical and organizational safeguards to protect information handled by MetaMindful, including encryption in transit and at rest where applicable.

sections.title: 7. DATA SECURITY
paragraphs: Rigorous security measures are employed to protect your data. Should there be a security breach, we pledge to notify the affected users promptly and take all necessary remedial actions.

sections.title: 8. USER RIGHTS
paragraphs: You have the right to inquire about your data and its utilization. At any point, you can request the deletion of your data.

sections.title: 9. CHILDREN'S USE
paragraphs: MetaMindful is not intended for users under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under 16. If we become aware that such data has been provided, we will take steps to delete it.

sections.title: 10. APPLE APP STORE PROVISIONS
paragraphs: Our data practices comply with Apple's guidelines for data collection and usage. We abide by Apple's tracking transparency requirements, ensuring no data is used for unauthorized tracking purposes.

sections.title: 11. CHANGES TO PRIVACY POLICY
paragraphs: In case of updates to our Privacy Policy, they will be reflected on this page. Significant changes will be communicated to users via the app.

sections.title: 12. MENTAL HEALTH SAFETY NOTICE
paragraphs: MetaMindful is designed for mental wellness support and personal reflection. The platform is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any mental health condition. The AI Coach does not replace licensed mental health professionals.
sections.callout: If you are experiencing severe distress, suicidal thoughts, or a mental health crisis, please contact emergency services or a crisis hotline immediately.

sections.title: 13. CRISIS SUPPORT
paragraphs: If you are in the United States and need immediate help: 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline â€” Call or text 988.
If you are outside the United States, please contact local emergency services or a mental health professional.

sections.title: 14. AI LIMITATIONS STATEMENT
paragraphs: The AI Coach provides educational guidance based on behavioral science principles. Responses are generated automatically and may not always be accurate or appropriate for every situation. Users should exercise judgment and seek professional help when needed.

sections.title: 15. CONTACT
paragraphs: For any inquiries, questions or concerns, please contact us at: info@metamindful.ai
